name: Gutenberg Editor
description: Advanced, yet easy to use content editor. Activate it on the content type edit page.
project_description:
Drupal Gutenberg is an editor that brings the powerful admin features of the Gutenberg Editor to Drupal. The module has powerful ways of mapping content to content type fields, define fixed layouts and also turn off some of the liberal flexibility that you don't want for larger sites and big marketing teams.
